name: AUZIX 20 — Preserved Live Recovery Build
summary: Derive AuziX from the pinned bootable ISO's embedded SquashFS, applying only committed SSH and InstallerEFL deltas before VM135 validation.
notes: Executable recovery workflow. It pins the input ISO/SquashFS hashes and AuziX source commit, retains kernel 6.1.0-48 and the original boot map, and never rebuilds the Docker image or broad root. AUZIX 30 validates VM135 runtime behavior.
